# SEOAgent session summary — "127.0.0.1:44883"

## 🚨 Biggest issue
**The repo you asked me to optimize isn't what's actually running at the live URL — in both directions.** `app/page.tsx`, `app/blog/page.tsx`, and `app/layout.tsx` are the only route files that exist, yet the live site serves 200s for `/features`, `/pricing`, and 12 individual `/blog/post-N` pages with **no source file anywhere in this checkout**. Conversely, `app/layout.tsx` had a stale fallback `<title>InboxZap — Clean Your Inbox in Minutes</title>` that the live homepage already doesn't use (it serves "Lumina — The AI Meeting Assistant for Teams"). I fixed what's genuinely in my control (see below), but I can't safely fabricate `/features` or `/pricing` page source from scratch — 👉 **I need you to tell me where those pages and the legacy blog posts actually live** (a different app? CMS? reverse proxy?) so canonical/schema fixes and the 301s below land in the right place.

## What I did
- **Ran the live crawl**, built `evidence.md`/`findings.md`, and wrote the full technical audit to `.seoagent/audit/latest.md`.
- **Fixed the broken `/blog`**: it was a client component fetching a `/api/posts` endpoint that returns 404 (confirmed dead dependency). Rewrote it as a server-rendered route reading real files from `content/blog/*.md`, added `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx` with `Article` JSON-LD, and wired real posts into the sitemap. Verified with a clean `npm run build`. **Not live yet** — production isn't currently built from this checkout, so re-curling the live site still shows the old broken version.
- **Rebranded stale InboxZap metadata** in `app/layout.tsx` to Lumina, and reconciled the repo's JSON-LD with what the live page already serves (per `verify-recs`'s correction: this was bringing source in line with production, not adding something new).
- **Ran GSC migration planning** (your `gsc/` export showed the site's history is almost entirely the old "InboxZap" email-cleanup product): `strategy/migration-plan.md` — 1 harvest (the homepage, corrected from a tool misclassification), 51 redirect, 0 sunset.
- **Drafted `context.md`** with real facts (Free up to 5 seats, Pro $12/seat, Enterprise custom — all sourced from the live pricing page) and **built one forward keyword cluster** (`ai-meeting-assistant-for-teams`: 1 pillar + 5 sub-pillars + 10 long-tails) from WebSearch, since no cloud login was available for real GSC/volume data.
- Per the "stop at the plan" rule for an unattended session, **I did not write any new articles** — that's queued in `roadmap.md` for next session's approval.

## What's working
- Titles, meta descriptions, OG/Twitter tags, and canonicals are already solid on 3 of 4 live pages; homepage already has `Organization`+`SoftwareApplication` JSON-LD; `robots.txt` is clean; no orphan pages.

## What do you want to do?
1. Tell me where `/features`, `/pricing`, and the legacy blog posts are actually served from, so I can apply the remaining fixes (canonical, schema, alt text, the 12 legacy-post redirects).
2. Approve the `ai-meeting-assistant-for-teams` content plan in `roadmap.md` so I can start writing the pillar article next session.
3. Confirm whether/when this repo gets deployed, so the `/blog` and metadata fixes actually go live.
